name: Santa Cruz
tagline: Beach town with a boardwalk, cliffs, and redwoods nearby.
description: A relaxed coastal town on the north end of Monterey Bay. Weekends mix a classic beach boardwalk, an ocean-cliff path, and short drives to redwood parks.

fromSanFrancisco.typicalTravel: About 1.5–2 hours by car; traffic on Highway 17 and Highway 1 varies

gettingAround.summary: Downtown, the wharf, and the boardwalk are walkable or bikeable; a car helps for redwood parks and nearby beaches.

highlights.title: West Cliff Drive and Natural Bridges
highlights.note: An oceanfront path ending at a state beach.

highlights.title: Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park
highlights.note: Easy redwood trails a short drive inland.

highlights.title: Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk and Wharf
highlights.note: A seaside amusement park and a long wooden wharf.

highlights.title: Museum of Art & History (MAH)
highlights.note: A small downtown museum with rotating exhibits.

highlights.title: Downtown and Westside cafés
highlights.note: Casual coffee stops near Pacific Avenue.

weatherNotes: Mild year-round; summer mornings are often foggy, and early fall is usually the clearest and warmest.

demoDailyBudgetPerPersonUsd.note: Fabricated demo range, not a current price.

travelTips: Summer weekends are busy; arrive early for beach parking.
Ocean water is cold year-round; check posted beach and surf conditions.
